content.tagline: Korean professional scalp and anti-hair-loss care by Dr.Pelo
content.descriptor: Dr.Pelo — Korean professional scalp care and a functional anti-hair-loss line the brand states is approved by the KFDA. Owned by JRM Holdings.
about: Dr.Pelo is a Korean professional scalp- and hair-care brand, owned by JRM Holdings. It works from a simple idea — that hair problems begin at the scalp — and builds its routine around cleansing buildup, calming the scalp and supporting the roots.

The brand states that its anti-hair-loss formulation is approved by the KFDA and was studied clinically with Korea University Ansan Hospital as a functional product for relieving hair loss. These are the company's own statements; Teranova presents them for B2B partners and does not independently verify them. Prices and commercial terms are shared on request, not published.

lines.name: Scalp & hair care
lines.note: A focused, scalp-first routine: the Scalp Shampoo and Scalp Tonic for anti-hair-loss care, and the Hair & Scalp Wipes for on-the-go cleansing between washes.

tech.name: Scalp-first approach
tech.note: The brand describes hair loss as starting at the scalp — buildup, inflammation, poor nutrient supply and weakened roots — and works to cleanse and exfoliate the scalp, support circulation and balance scalp pH (about 4.5–5.5).

tech.name: Key actives, per the brand
tech.note: L-Menthol to refresh the scalp and remove buildup, Salicylic Acid to gently exfoliate and unclog pores, and Dexpanthenol to help the scalp barrier hold moisture. Presented as the brand states them.
